chunks: 'Ali, from his father, from more than one [narrator], from Yunus, from 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, from Abi al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) — he said: I heard him say:

The sunnah for carrying the funeral bier is that you face the side of the bier with your right flank, then grip the left [side] with your right palm, then proceed along it to the fourth side that is near your left [side].

key_terms.السَّرِيرِ: sareer — the bier/bed on which the body is laid and carried
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: sunnah — the prescribed imamic practice for this act
key_terms.الْأَيْمَنِ: al-ayman — the right [side]; used twice to specify right flank and right palm
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: janazah — the funeral bier; the act of carrying the deceased
key_terms.يَسَارَكَ: yasarak — your left side; the directional endpoint marking completion of the rotation

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah method for carrying the funeral bier (tarbī' al-janāzah) according to Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) in al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) prescribes the sunnah method for the four-cornered carrying of the funeral bier (tarbī' al-janāzah): the bearer faces the side of the bier with his right flank, grips the left side with his right palm, then proceeds around it to the fourth corner near his left side. This ruling, transmitted through the trusted companion Ali ibn Yaqtin, provides precise jurisprudential guidance on rotating through all four carrying positions, a practice regarded as meritorious in Shia fiqh.
